title: Attention logit scaling: a controlled empirical mechanism check
research_questions: Under controlled sampling of query and key vectors, does dividing by sqrt(d_k) normalize the variance of attention logits and reduce softmax concentration and gradient attenuation, as the standard derivation predicts?
How closely do measured logit standard deviations match the theoretical sqrt(d_k)*sigma_q*sigma_k across d_k values?
How sensitive are softmax concentration and gradient magnitude to the scale factor at fixed d_k?
How does relaxing the unit-variance or zero-mean assumptions shift the scale that normalizes the logits?
